What is AgentOps

AgentOps is an AI agent directory and deployment platform. We bring together 5 specialist AI agents Lead Generation, Customer Support, Content & Social Media, Outbound Sales and Workflow Automation - so your business can automate real work without a dev team.

https://framer.link/isaacdsign

Do I need coding skills to use AgentOps?

None at all. AgentOps is built for non-technical teams. You pick your agent, connect your existing tools in one click and go live in minutes. No code, no setup headaches, no developer required.

https://framer.link/isaacdsign

Which tools and apps do the agents connect to?

AgentOps agents connect with Slack, HubSpot, Gmail, Notion, Airtable, Stripe, Shopify and LinkedIn out of the box. More integrations are added every month based on user requests.

https://framer.link/isaacdsign

How long does it take to deploy my first agent?

Most users deploy their first agent in under 7 minutes. Pick your agent, connect your tools and hit deploy — the agent starts working immediately.

https://framer.link/isaacdsign

Can I run more than one agent at the same time?

Yes. On the Business plan you can run all 5 agents simultaneously. Each one operates independently — your Lead Generation agent and Customer Support agent can both run 24/7 without interfering with each other.

https://framer.link/isaacdsign

What happens if an agent makes a mistake?

Every agent run is fully logged with step-by-step breakdowns. You can review, edit or rerun any task at any time. Complex or sensitive actions can be set to require your approval before executing.

https://framer.link/isaacdsign
